Both parties' surviving evidence points the same way, and the fee cannot stand.

His closest recorded approach across the whole trip is 53.08 m (driver_track.min_distance_m), and the derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes with a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 s. POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-in-radius-fix test is therefore not met, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the effective in-geofence dwell under POL-NS-06 is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this trip (EV-TRIP-02720, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) - a 180 s shortfall. Under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full. The same result follows on the wrong-face reading: the driver's closest point (53.08 m) lies outside the arrival radius but far inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, and POL-NS-03 likewise refunds the fee in full.

Amount. EV-FARE-02720 shows the cancellation-fee line and total_charged at SGD 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The amount refunded is that SGD 4.50 line; the SGD 6.61 gross figure is not what was charged.

Driver compensation - none. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. Its anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 of completed_trips_30d 134 = 0.0075, below both the count-4 and the 0.08 rate limbs), so nothing is withheld on that ground, but there is no fee entitlement to compensate. Nor does POL-NS-03 produce goodwill: the rider named no entrance, block or sub-location (her only message is 'ok'), so limb (i) does not apply, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not the 2 or more limb (ii) requires, so the 50% pin-ambiguity payment (SGD 2.25) is not payable either.

The parties' accounts. The driver's statement 'I was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own trace (closest 53.08 m) and cannot carry the arrival fact; the trace governs. The rider's track (66 stationary fixes, 14.62-20.74 m from the pin) confirms she was at the pickup point. Her POL-NS-04 claim is not the ground of the refund and would not apply on its own terms anyway - 'ok' is an acknowledgement, not the locating or coordinating content limb (a) requires - but the full refund she seeks is granted under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06.

Referrals - none. The arrival marker is not a POL-NS-05 false-arrival event: the driver was within 300 m of the pin (closest 53.08 m) and is not shown at 15 km/h or more at the marker, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire, and no other clause produces a referral on these facts.

Weight and confidence. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-02720, EV-TRIP-02720 and EV-FARE-02720, all at weight 1.0, so none of them caps confidence. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02720-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT): its absence makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulated dwell unavailable, but it carries no deciding fact, does not impair the driver's track, and does not move the cap (POL-NS-11). No POL-NS-08(a)-(d) or POL-NS-09 trigger is met. This is an automated ruling made without human review; the appeal route is POL-GEN-04.

Why the fee does not stand. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02720, COMPLETE, weight 1.0, 100% coverage, 73 fixes at a 10 s cadence, no gaps) never places him inside the arrival geofence. For the STANDARD zone class the arrival radius is 50 m (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m, POL-NS-02); the derived arrival block records qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s, and the driver's closest approach to the pin over the whole trip is 53.08 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m). There is therefore no qualifying in-radius fix at any point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and under POL-NS-02 the fee is not chargeable. The driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 12:31:25 (EV-TRIP-02720) is a driver-pressed marker - arrival_marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 platform-confirmed arrival does not apply - and it records only that the driver tapped it, not that he was at the pin; his statement 'I was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own trace and cannot carry the arrival fact. The trace shows him stopped just outside the radius and within 400 m of the pin, which is the POL-NS-03 wrong-spot case: he did not arrive at the pickup point and the fee is refunded in full. Independently, on dwell: the platform started a 180 s free-wait timer at 12:31:27 and the driver cancelled at 12:37:28, but the qualifying in-geofence dwell is 0.0 s against the 180 s free-wait period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, POL-NS-01(c)) - a shortfall of 180 s - so POL-NS-06 also makes the fee unchargeable. Whether the pattern is read as a no-arrival (POL-NS-02) or a wrong-spot stop (POL-NS-03), the result is the same full refund.

Driver compensation: none. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (b) fails. The anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 134, a rate of 0.007, both limbs required), but compensation is not payable in any event. Under POL-NS-03 the fault allocation from the chat log gives the driver nothing: the rider named no entrance, block or bay, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill of limb (ii), which requires 2 or more registered points, does not apply.

The claim that POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider (her message 'ok' at 12:32:55, no reply, no in-app call) is rejected: limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message, and 'ok' is neither, so POL-NS-04 does not fire and is not the ground of this refund. The rider's track (66 fixes, all qualifying, 14.62 m to 20.74 m from the pin, stationary) confirms she was at the pickup point; that corroborates her account but does not alter the ground of the refund. EV-ADVIS-02720-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT): POL-NS-06 limb (i) dwell-accumulation is unavailable to the driver, and a missing advisory never reduces the required minimum or excuses the shortfall. No artifact carrying a deciding fact is impaired - EV-GPS-02720 and EV-TRIP-02720 both stand at weight 1.0 - so the confidence cap is 1.0. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger applies: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no two admissible artifacts contradict on arrival, dwell or rider presence in a way no clause resolves, no repeat-party pattern appears (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0), the anti-farming check does not trip, and the deciding trace is not impaired. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and executes automatically. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
